Package com.kerosene.kfe.paymentexecution.adapters.out.execution

Class KfeExecutionTransactionHelper

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.paymentexecution.adapters.out.execution.KfeExecutionTransactionHelper
@Service public class KfeExecutionTransactionHelper extends Object
Coordinates transaction-bound persistence for the payment execution outbox.

The helper validates worker claims and intent bindings, reconciles actual fees, records balance movements and transaction projections, and routes uncertain external outcomes to manual reconciliation. External notifications and potentially slow observations run after commit so database locks are not held across network calls.

  • Method Details

    • prepare

      @Transactional public KfeExecutionTransactionHelper.PreparationResult prepare(UUID outboxId, UUID claimToken)
      Locks the outbox and transaction, validates the claim and authorized envelope, and returns the immutable data the worker needs to call the external payment provider.
      Parameters:
      outboxId - durable execution item to prepare
      claimToken - lease token proving current worker ownership
      Returns:
      executable provider input, or a skip result when the item is missing, terminal, invalid, inbound-only or requires reconciliation
      Throws:
      KfeExecutionClaimLostException - if the claim is absent, expired or owned by another worker

    • recordOutboundBroadcast

      @Transactional public void recordOutboundBroadcast(UUID outboxId, UUID transactionId, UUID claimToken, String provider, String providerReference, String blockchainTxid, long feeSats, UUID sourceWalletId, String providerPayload)
      Persists a successful on-chain broadcast while leaving the source reserve locked until confirmation-based settlement. Follow-up peer exposure, deposit observation and notice dispatch occur only after commit.
      Parameters:
      outboxId - execution item acknowledged by the worker
      transactionId - transaction identified by that item
      claimToken - current worker lease token
      provider - provider that broadcast the transaction
      providerReference - provider-side acknowledgement reference
      blockchainTxid - broadcast transaction ID; required and normalized before storage
      feeSats - actual network fee reported by the provider
      sourceWalletId - source wallet that funded the transaction
      providerPayload - optional provider response retained only as a hash in projections
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the transaction ID or source wallet does not match, or if the broadcast transaction ID is blank
      KfeExecutionClaimLostException - if this worker no longer owns the outbox claim

    • touchOutboundConfirmations

      @Transactional(propagation=REQUIRES_NEW) public void touchOutboundConfirmations(UUID transactionId, int confirmations, String blockHash, Integer blockHeight)
      Persists the latest chain confirmation count independently of a potentially failing settle. A decrease before settlement is visible as a reorg; after settlement it moves the payment to reconciliation. The supplied block metadata is used for audit context only.
      Parameters:
      transactionId - payment whose chain observation changed
      confirmations - latest observed confirmation count
      blockHash - block hash associated with the observation, if available
      blockHeight - block height associated with the observation, if available

    • settleOutboundWhenConfirmed

      @Transactional public boolean settleOutboundWhenConfirmed(UUID transactionId, int confirmations)
      Settles an on-chain outbound payment after its monitor has verified sufficient confirmations. It persists confirmation progress first, validates the state and source, then consumes the reserved debit and records audit, statement and idempotency projections. Negative confirmations are treated as unresolved evidence and never authorize a refund.
      Parameters:
      transactionId - payment to settle
      confirmations - current confirmation count from the trusted monitor
      Returns:
      true when already settled or newly settled; false when the payment is missing, lacks required broadcast data, has an unsupported state or remains unresolved

    • settleOutbound

      @Transactional public void settleOutbound(UUID outboxId, UUID transactionId, UUID claimToken, String provider, String providerReference, String blockchainTxid, long feeSats, UUID sourceWalletId, String providerPayload)
      Performs immediate outbound settlement for rails whose provider result is final (for example, Lightning). On-chain production uses broadcast recording and confirmation-gated settlement.
      Parameters:
      outboxId - execution item acknowledged by the worker
      transactionId - payment identified by the item
      claimToken - current worker lease token
      provider - execution provider name
      providerReference - provider-side result reference
      blockchainTxid - chain transaction ID, if produced by this rail
      feeSats - actual execution fee in satoshis
      sourceWalletId - source wallet whose reserve is settled
      providerPayload - optional provider response stored only as a hash
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the claim references another transaction or source wallet
      KfeExecutionClaimLostException - if the claim is no longer owned by this worker

    • validateFeeBeforeBroadcast

      public static KfeExecutionTransactionHelper.FeeValidationResult validateFeeBeforeBroadcast(long estimatedFeeSats, long reservedFeeSats, long amountSats, long maxFeeRate, long maxAbsoluteFee, long maxFeeRatioPct)
      Compatibility validation utility; this method itself does not gate a broadcast. The caller must supply the estimated absolute fee and enforce the result.
      Parameters:
      estimatedFeeSats - the fee from the funded PSBT
      reservedFeeSats - the fee the user authorized
      amountSats - the amount being sent (for ratio check)
      maxFeeRate - retained for compatibility; unused without a virtual-size input
      maxAbsoluteFee - maximum absolute fee in sats (0 = skip check)
      maxFeeRatioPct - maximum fee as % of amount (0 = skip check)
